config kernel="${KERNEL}"

# Ensure that ulimit inside the VM is raised.
vimto exec -- sh -c 'ulimit -c'
stdout unlimited

# Trigger a core dump inside the VM. GNU coreutils' timeout will display the
# message: 'timeout: the monitored command dumped core', uutils' (Ubuntu 26.04
# and later) won't do that.
! vimto exec -- timeout -s QUIT 0.1s sleep 10
glob-exists core-*
